# XV Patch fixture

`srx03ap2-001.syx` is one XV-5080 Patch, User Patch 001 `United !`, cut
from Roland's free SRX-03 Studio SRX additional patch data (2001): the 9 DT1
messages at `30 00 xx xx` of `SRX03AP2.mid`, copied byte for byte from the
file's SysEx events (1,056 bytes).

- Original download: `ftp://ftp.roland.co.jp/pub/roland/japan/patch/SRX03ap2.EXE`,
  from the page `http://www.roland.co.jp/lib/download/SRX03_Patch.html`,
  fetched through the Wayback Machine. Corpus entry `wayback-ftp-roland-co-jp`,
  see [Collect a Foreign patch corpus outside the repo](https://github.com/sigma/integral/issues/197).
- File inside the archive: `SRX03AP2/SRX03AP2.mid` ("XV-5080 専用の SMF
  追加パッチデータです": SMF additional patch data for the XV-5080).
